sampling: SRS without replacement within all nonempty joint strata (mechanism, mediator, causal-role, chain); deterministic allocation before sampling
allocation: one record per nonempty stratum, then greedily maximize N_h/(n_h+1)
estimator: inverse-inclusion weighted; each stratum weight N_h/n_h
blinding: case IDs and random order; evaluated system, run, old judge labels and unit IDs not shown
rubric: verbatim released five-axis reasoning guide; gold references supplied
runtime: independent Codex sub-agent with no conversation-history fork; not original provider API campaign
reliability_scope: cross-model sensitivity, not biological correctness; same GPT model family for some comparisons
